claims.text: Miles’s colonial retrospective separates the fort garrison from Mombasa’s town wali and describes Khalid’s coercive seizure of Rashid and Mazrui companions. The government-hosted composite places Said’s court in Zanzibar alongside enslaved plantation labour. A fort, town office and court are different relations; court presence does not establish sole-capital abandonment, local consent or identical power.
